customer_message.subject: Request for help contesting termination of tenancy at Feldstrasse 39, Luzern
customer_message.body: Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing to ask for your help in contesting the termination of my tenancy at Feldstrasse 39 in Luzern, a 4-room flat rented from Immobilien Seeblick AG. The flat is our family home. My spouse lives here with me, and we have done so since the tenancy began. I believe the landlord is ending our tenancy as retaliation. In recent months I complained to the landlord about defects in the flat and questioned the rent I am being charged. The decision followed shortly after those complaints, and I do not think it is a coincidence. I would like to ask for an extension of the tenancy. Moving out by the end date would cause us serious hardship. Our children attend the local school, and a housing search in Luzern within a short time would be very difficult for us. I would appreciate it if you could check whether my legal expenses cover advice and representation in this matter, and what the next steps would be. I can provide the correspondence about the defects and the rent. Please contact me by e-mail or phone at your convenience. Kind regards, Rowan Price
